about.title: about
about.paragraph_1: books that a person never opens will remain undisclosed—and books set in cement even more so. i take legal literature as the basis of the project to speak about unsolved crimes. the theme is played through inversion: undisclosed cases are literally enclosed in cement books that cannot be opened. these are stitched and sealed stories that can never again become public. by erasing a book from the public field, we also erase the markers of history and experience that occurred in that space.
